description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mrs. I. N. Weerasekera to the President's Staff w.e.f 12.03.2018
categorisation: This gazette content solely announces the appointment of a named individual (Mrs. I. N. Weerasekera) to a specific government position (Senior Assistant Secretary to the President). It includes the person's name and title but provides no details about her portfolio responsibilities, duties, or subject matter areas she will be handling. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
